d: Kris has to learn how to deal with the wealthy world of horse racing. The farm is in financial difficulty because it does not have a winning horse.
Kris Furillo is released from the juvenile detention center and begins working at the Ritter family ranch.
Kris is released from the juvenile detention center and readjusts to life on the ranch  Dani tries to get Kris in trouble.
Kris' mother pays a surprise visit to the ranch  Dani becomes involved with a bookie  Jean's engagement ring is stolen.
Veterinary bills and an impending IRS audit worry Jean  Kris gets a waitressing job  Matt falls deeper into the world of gambling.
Kris promises to go on a date with Junior if he will stake a claim on Wildfire in an upcoming race  Dani learns that Bobby is married.
Kris, Matt, Junior and Dani head to the mountains when their horses are lost in a stampede  Jean's ex-husband interrupts her date with Charlie.
Wildfire loses a big race after ingesting potentially lethal cattle feed  Matt must sell his motorcycle to cover gambling debts.
